notes.title: Circuits update released!
notes.content:
[img=http://onebraverobot.com/img/slowdrive/circuits2.gif][/img]

[h1]Hello slowdrivers! ːslowdriverː[/h1]

New update is now available. It contains 12 new circuit tracks, bonus paints and several bug fixes. New tracks are short as always but to get a good result you'll have to find a perfect racing line.
And bonus paints have a cool magic dust effect:

[img=http://onebraverobot.com/img/slowdrive/bonus_paint.jpg][/img]

Keep driving!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28570097/c70fe8f59e9535ccbc2c39b011f0daff7c5d4948.png[/img]

notes.title: Latest updates and Steam Leaderboards support
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]
At first, thanks to all players for helping me improve the Slowdrive.

[b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] are now available. In the early days the leaderboard will differ from the in-game rating. To appear in the global leaderboard you just need to run the game, but to appear in the level leaderboard you have to finish this level with any result - only your best time will be sent to Steam Leaderboard. Global leaderboard score is the sum of all your times at all levels. If the level is not played yet the time is counted as three minutes.

[b]Steam Controller[/b] now works in xbox360 configuration, just be sure that in-game option "Unity Input" is on.

Also, a few bugs were fixed, mostly related to controllers support.

See you on the tree!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28570097/460af62084450763018cd56d50911ecb3abdedea.png[/img]
